name: omp-dev-team
description: Persona-driven AI development team for Oh-My-Pi — port of agentic-dev-team with local-model routing for the small tier.
comment: This repo is both an OMP workspace and a marketplace plugin. Marketplace catalog: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (plugin dev-team@omp-dev-team, source ./.omp). Plugin/extension manifest: .omp/package.json (omp.extensions). The ROOT intentionally declares no omp.extensions: a marketplace install delivers agents/skills/knowledge/commands/MCP but NOT extension modules, so the 8 guard/routing extensions are wired per-project via `extensions: [<clone>/.omp]` (or `omp plugin link <clone>/.omp`). See README Installation.
